safeguard: Fees round half up to whole cents
default_label: The fee is truncated through a float

variants.label: Integer division drops the rounding term
variants.root_cause: transfer_fee_cents() floors the fee with integer division and drops the + 5,000 rounding term, so half-cent fees are cut off.

variants.label: The rounding term is 500, ten times too small
variants.root_cause: transfer_fee_cents() adds 500 instead of 5,000 before dividing by 10,000, so fees that should round up from half a cent are cut off.
